mode.create_better_wrench.wrench.desc:
The standard Create wrench experience
If it is in the offhand, only this function works
mode.create_better_wrench.connect.desc:
[RMB] Pick a start, corner and end point; the drivetrain is built for you
[Ctrl+Scroll] Switch how corner nodes are built {Gearbox/Large Cogwheel}
mode.create_better_wrench.deconstruct.de:
[RMB] Select an area; remove everything a wrench can remove
[Ctrl+Scroll] Switch the filter {All/Create only/Redstone only}
mode.create_better_wrench.assemble.desc:
[RMB] Lock a depot to process whatever sits on it
With several items, the extras wait nearby as unpickable drops
[Ctrl+Scroll] Adjust how long the product stays

gui.create_better_wrench.config.title: Universal Wrench · Config
gui.create_better_wrench.config.reset.ti: Restore every option to its default value (saved when you close the page)
gui.create_better_wrench.config.hint: Drag the sliders; - / + fine-tune (Shift x10, Ctrl x100); saved when you close the page
gui.create_better_wrench.config.readonly: Read-only: the server provides this config, the client cannot change it
gui.create_better_wrench.config.step.tip: Click to fine-tune: hold Shift for x10, Ctrl for x100
gui.create_better_wrench.config.opt.deco: Deconstruct: max edge of a selection (blocks)
gui.create_better_wrench.config.desc.dec: If any axis of the selection is longer, the request is rejected (nothing is removed) and the client draws the box red.
Higher removes faster but makes a single tick heavier; lower is smoother but takes longer.
gui.create_better_wrench.config.desc.con: Beyond this you cannot add more corners (an action-bar hint appears).
gui.create_better_wrench.config.opt.conn: Connect: max length of one segment (blocks)
gui.create_better_wrench.config.desc.con: Maximum straight length between two nodes; add a corner to go farther.
Maximum blocks placed by one connection (shafts/gearboxes/large cogwheels); also a server-side safety cap.
create_better_wrench.ponder.wrench_conne: Linking Stress using the Universal Wrench
Right-clicking a block that can join a stress network will set the start
Right-clicking along the way will add a corner
Right-clicking another block that can join the network will set the end
The transmission structure will be built
Ctrl and Scroll will switch how a corner is built
create_better_wrench.ponder.wrench_decon: Removing Blocks using the Universal Wrench
The Universal Wrench can remove a whole area at once
Right-clicking a block will set the first corner
Right-clicking the opposite corner will finish the selection
Ctrl and Scroll will switch which blocks are in scope
Only blocks that match the current scope will be removed
create_better_wrench.ponder.wrench_proce: Processing Items using the Universal Wrench
Right-clicking a Depot will lock it
While locked, items on top can be processed
Processing covers Assembly, Filling, Washing, Blasting, Smoking and Haunting
Assembly
When a usable assembly material is on the Depot (a Golden Sheet, for example)
Adding the matching materials will assemble it
Filling
When a fillable material is on the Depot (a Blaze Cake Base, for example)
Right-clicking it with the matching fluid bucket will fill it
Several materials on the Depot will be filled according to the recipe
Washing
When a usable item is on the Depot (Gravel, for example)
Right-clicking it with a Water Bucket will wash it
Blasting
When a smeltable item is on the Depot (Raw Iron, for example)
Right-clicking it with a Lava Bucket will blast it
Smoking
When a cookable item is on the Depot (Raw Beef, for example)
Right-clicking it with Flint and Steel will smoke it (using durability)
Haunting
When the Depot sits on Soul Sand or Soul Soil
Haunting can be performed
When a hauntable item is on the Depot (Sand, for example)
Right-clicking it with Flint and Steel will haunt it
create_better_wrench.ponder.tag.wrench.d: Everything the wrench can do - all nine scenes (linking, deconstructing, six kinds of processing)
gui.create_better_wrench.config.desc.con: When off the mode can still be selected, but every attempt reports it as unavailable and nothing is placed.
gui.create_better_wrench.config.desc.dec: When off the mode can still be selected, but every attempt reports it as unavailable.
When off only redstone parts can be removed (the scope is locked to redstone only).
When off only Create blocks can be removed (scope locked to create only). Turning both off also disables the master switch.
gui.create_better_wrench.config.desc.pro: When off the mode can still be selected, but every attempt reports it as unavailable (locking/unlocking a Depot too). Turning it on enables all six kinds below.
Sequenced assembly and deployer-style applying; when off the attempt only reports the sub-feature as unavailable and consumes nothing.
Pouring fluid from a bucket onto the item; when off the attempt only reports the sub-feature as unavailable.
Rinsing with a water bucket; when off the attempt only reports the sub-feature as unavailable.
High heat with a lava bucket; when off the attempt only reports the sub-feature as unavailable.
Smoking with flint and steel; when off the attempt only reports the sub-feature as unavailable.
Haunting on a soul base with flint and steel; when off the attempt only reports the sub-feature as unavailable.
gui.create_better_wrench.config.desc.com: Combat mode is the easter egg (toggle with Ctrl in the mod description mode: +5 damage / +20 attack speed). When off nobody can toggle it on.
Everyone = any player; OP = permission level 2. Individual players can also be authorized with /cbw combat <selector> true, which bypasses this level.
gui.create_better_wrench.config.hint: Click a switch to toggle; drag sliders, or use - / + (Shift x10, Ctrl x100); saved and applied when you close the screen
